title: Spatiotemporal dynamics in airborne fungi and fungal allergens dataset across the United States
description: This dataset examines the airborne fungal assemblage across national parks in the US for the year 2021 in order to assess the spatial and seasonal dynamics that explain the fungal assemblages found.
